description: This file defines the CognitoSyncClient class, a client for interacting with the Amazon Cognito Sync service within the AWS SDK for PHP. It provides method signatures for various operations like listing datasets, describing identity pools, and managing device subscriptions, along with their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: CognitoSyncClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with Amazon Cognito Sync service, extending the AwsClient base class.

methods.name: bulkPublish
methods.description: Publishes all data that has changed in a specific dataset to the cloud.

methods.name: describeIdentityPoolUsage
methods.description: Provides information about the usage of an identity pool.

methods.name: describeIdentityUsage
methods.description: Provides information about the usage of an identity.

methods.name: getBulkPublishDetails
methods.description: Retrieves details about the last bulk publish operation.

methods.name: getCognitoEvents
methods.description: Gets the configuration of Cognito events.

methods.name: getIdentityPoolConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration of an identity pool.

methods.name: listIdentityPoolUsage
methods.description: Lists the usage history of the identity pools.

methods.name: registerDevice
methods.description: Registers a device to the identity.

methods.name: setCognitoEvents
methods.description: Sets the Cognito events for an identity pool.

methods.name: subscribeToDataset
methods.description: Subscribes a device to a dataset.

methods.name: unsubscribeFromDataset
methods.description: Unsubscribes a device from a dataset.
